capabilities.contract: 14 defined tools: 10 reads and 4 writes. Each agent receives its registry allowed_tools intersection with known schemas, not the whole catalog automatically. Frontline writes are tool-authorized; Jarvis proposal approval is a separate lane, not a universal customer yes/no gate.
capabilities.adaptation: Correct DOCX's 13-tool count. Retain source-backed answers and no-human-notification-without-receipt language. Do not market order cancellation, price changes, discounts, scheduling or code execution.

capabilities.observed: Products/edging handlers and products postback query active global catalogs without an account predicate; products postback calls getProductText() without getBindings. Order lookup uses substring matching of up to 20 recent client orders, not a guaranteed exact exhaustive order-number lookup. Quote postback prompts for dimensions; it is not a deterministic pricing calculator.
capabilities.risk_status: Catalog ownership and public/private classification require explicit data-contract review and synthetic route reproduction. Static absence of an account predicate is a concrete scope gap against DOCX's claim, not proof of a live data leak. Candidate catalog/document handlers shown here have no isFreshRecord expiry check.
capabilities.adaptation: P0: classify shared vs tenant catalog, bind account on private routes, define freshness semantics and exact order lookup. P1: a separately tested deterministic quote service with unit/VAT/minimum/rounding rules if authorized; formal sales acceptance remains separate.

capabilities.observed: Customer recall, task listing, prompt hydration and card memory count include both client_account_id and line_user_id predicates. Memory types have a bounded allowlist. This supports scoped memory behavior in candidate source, not model training.
capabilities.adaptation: Retain current scope tests and add any new cross-user/account/department tests before extending the contract. Customer memory and operator notes must remain separate.

capabilities.contract: 7-day HMAC link; active bound tenant/department authorization; original retained in private neurohands-docs bucket; client_documents records source and parse state. Legacy path is 10 MiB. Opt-in resumable path has hard ceiling 50,000,000 bytes and /ready checks configured ceiling equals bucket ceiling. No live enablement verified.

capabilities.contract: Founder or active admin; founder-only activation secret; 13 Jarvis schemas: list_clients + operations_status + 9 reads + propose_note + propose_action. Write proposals require the same operator yes; nh_claim_note claims pending row before execution. Availability of read tools does not grant all tools or external integrations.

capabilities.observed: Candidate returns failure for empty Gemini final text; fallback conversation restarts only when no tools executed. It does not establish the DOCX's tools:[] synthesis recovery. Delivery race sends Checking after 2.5 seconds then push final; catch rethrows without the claimed checkingDelivered recovery. Multi-Gemini exact in-flight failover is not established by this code.
capabilities.adaptation: P0: reproduce post-tool empty final and delayed delivery failure with synthetic deterministic transport/provider fixtures. Preserve tool receipts and prevent replay before implementing any continuity recovery.

capabilities.contract: Web is browser ES modules/HTML/CSS with Vite; it edits authenticated workspace definitions and immutable published revisions. It is not React in the inspected source and publishing is not execution. Fixed named specialist workflows are local and have no production adapters.
capabilities.adaptation: P2: define explicit published-version-to-runtime binding, approved tool catalog, lifecycle and tenancy adapter before any Studio -> LINE team execution. No generic application MCP integration is implemented; Codex engineering connectors are not Aria/Jarvis tools.
